title: Values at work

captions.instagram:
My parents gave us three values: togetherness, family and hard work. Here's how I'd translate each one into a business.

Togetherness: teams that share goals and information. Family: trust, long-term thinking and mentoring. My father was also my mentor. Hard work: showing up, and learning by doing.

#Leadership #FamilyBusiness #Values

What value would you add?
captions.facebook:
Togetherness, family, hard work. Three values from my Brooklyn childhood, and what I think they look like at work.

#Leadership #Values

Which value runs your workplace?
captions.linkedin:
The values you grow up with can become the way you run a business.

My parents gave us three: togetherness, family and hard work. How I'd translate them:

Togetherness: teams that share goals and information, and decisions that are explained, not just announced.
Family: loyalty, trust and long-term thinking. Mentoring matters; my father was also my mentor.
Hard work: showing up for the unglamorous work, and learning by doing. By 16, I had started four electronics and music stores.

#Leadership #Values

Which value shapes your work most?
